name: Slices
author: Addicting Games
description:
Dive into the delightful challenge of Slices, a captivating puzzle arcade game where your objective is to assemble as many complete watermelons as possible. With each slice, strategize your moves to create neat piles and maximize your score in this addictive fruit-fueled adventure.

Test your skills and reflexes as you slice through juicy watermelons, aiming for perfection in each arrangement. With no levels to hold you back, the thrill of beating your own high score drives the gameplay, offering endless replayability and satisfaction.
